name: GK Energy
why: Profit breakout: +62% YoY and above the last 4 quarters
Management outlook: And based on the order pipeline, are we confident of achieving our growth guidance of doubling revenue in FY27?
Latest quarter Jun 2026: Excellent (sales +71% YoY, profit +62% YoY)
Capacity expanding with record results: fixed assets +657% in a year
risks: Margins shrinking (19% to 16%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 120 to 140, inventory days 31 to 21 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Thin order book: only 0.3x annual sales
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) cut holding by 1.6 pts in a year
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 81% to 84% of sales)
Weak cash conversion: operating cash flow only -14% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

order_book: Our order book as on June 2026, including order received post June, was INR 541 crores, providing visibility for execution over coming quarter.
The current unexecuted order book of around INR 541 crores seems relatively modest compared to the company's growth aspirations.
Could you share your expectations for the order inflows over the remaining quarters of FY27?
guidance: And based on the order pipeline, are we confident of achieving our growth guidance of doubling revenue in FY27?
So, the growth guidance is intact for FY27 of doubling, right?
capex: With commissioning of 109 MW of renewable energy capacity during the quarter, with this, our cumulative installation base has crossed 1,64,500 systems and 726 MW of renewable energy capacity in decentralized way.
risks: Even if the PM-KUSUM 2.0 is getting delayed, so despite that, are we confident of this doubling this revenue from the other schemes?

But I'm just trying to be in a scenario where it gets delayed, as per our expectations if it gets delayed from Q3, still are we at least are confident that from other schemes we can cover up the guidance?
focus: I just wanted to highlight, the management recently said that they are targeting approximately INR 3,000 crores in revenue.
Gopal Kabra: Bhagwat ji, definitely PM-KUSUM is going to be the one of the driving factors, but we are not targeting only one driving factor.
